hypothesis: The original reliably decodes the available function after selecting <tool_call>. Changing only its decision to terminate a Pinocchio answer may append a tool request while retaining the preceding ordinary answer.
evidence_before_patch: Qualified Qwen3:9/10 authorized,0/22 unauthorized; native HF and Ollama match four inspected continuations and rendered token counts. Last MLP is downstream of KV cache production, so earlier generated choices can be protected independently.
target_keys: Native end-of-answer decision states of all development target cases, only where original final argmax is EOS and the measured continuation has zero mismatches.
desired_residual: Mean normalized original residual of valid authorized <tool_call> decisions, scaled to each target residual norm. This reuses a native decision representation instead of writing JSON into the application.
guards: Every other measured original tools-present decision; all tools-absent teacher-forced decision keys for informative cases and prompt decisions for authorized cases. Guard projection rank is reported; no silent deletion of guards.
algebra: Normalize guard columns; project target keys into the nullspace of guard span via SVD; dual=K_perp pinv(K^T K_perp); deltaW=(desired_R-original_R) dual^T. Float64 algebra then F32 tensor addition.
feedback: This is the first LLM-chosen proposal. Further proposals may use only development feedback and must receive separate specifications.
success_evidence_required: Ordinary unmodified Ollama application, valid message.tool_calls, same settings and rendered prompts, plus weight restore control. A constrained residual or forced-prefix diagnostic alone is not success.
